issue.title: test_real_fakey_retry_countdown / running_fallback PNG snapshots fail on every run: 15 s DONE-sentinel timeout in the workspace, a stable 491-pixel golden mismatch in worktrees
issue.description:
Two ACE retry end-to-end PNG snapshot tests fail deterministically on master and are not caused by the sase-11y.7 Services-tab phase:

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py::test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot`
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py::test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot`

Reproduce (2 of 2 runs failed in workspace sase_32 at master 6087c0a8e, 79 s and 102 s):

    just fix-tui-screenshots --check -- -k "test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot or test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot"

Two failure signatures, depending on where the test is run, and I did not establish why:

1. In the sase_32 workspace checkout via `just fix-tui-screenshots --check`: both nodes time out after 15.00 s inside `_reload_finished_agent(page)` waiting for the SVG sentinel `DONE` (`tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_png_snapshot_waits.py:42`).
2. In detached git worktrees under /tmp (`PYTHONPATH=<worktree>:<worktree>/src .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest visual -k ...`): both nodes render and then fail the golden comparison with the same 491/1520532 changed pixels (0.032291%), identically at 45a7895b6^, at 45a7895b6, and at 6087c0a8e.

Because the 491-pixel drift is byte-identical at all three commits, and they fail in each, no commit in that range explains it; the cause predates the sase-13i.2 tribe-panel work (45a7895b6, 2026-09-19). The original commit that broke them was not bisected. The two signatures suggest the frame content is not the whole story (a path-dependent difference between the workspace checkout and /tmp is one hypothesis), so establish which signature is the real one first.

Related but distinct: sase-x5 and sase-10u track broad Agents-pane golden drift; closed sase-dc stabilized these same two tests under full-suite contention, which is not this failure (these fail run alone). Do not just regenerate the goldens; find what changed in the rendered frame.

Measured while verifying the sase-11y.7 gate repair; the same two nodes also failed in the previous worker's baseline at 244442ee8. The other two nodes in that baseline (`test_agents_collapsed_panel_png_snapshot`, `test_queued_clan_counts_png_snapshot`) were caused by sase-13i.2 (45a7895b6) and are recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on epic sase-13i, not here.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed on every run: 2 of 2 in the sase_32 workspace via `just fix-tui-screenshots --check` at 6087c0a8e, and in detached-worktree replays at 45a7895b6^, 45a7895b6 and 6087c0a8e, each of which failed both nodes with a byte-identical 491-pixel diff (0.032291%). A rerun on the same tree never passed, the runs were serial or lightly parallel (not a saturated lane), and the diff size does not vary between runs or commits, so this is a stable rendering difference, not timing.

payload.entry: LIKELY FIXED BY sase-12z.5 — re-verify before launching a worker. This report's base is master 6087c0a8e (2026-09-20 09:35), which predates 9a56fc129 (phase sase-12z.5.2, on master since 10:02). That phase's note records these same two fakey retry e2e nodes as failures it fixed: it restored AgentList panel repainting when row content, jump hints, marks or fold state change under unchanged row identities, which the sase-13i.2 identity-only skip had dropped, so the DONE sentinel now actually reaches the rendered SVG. Evidence from the sase-12z.5 land agent on 2026-09-20 at master 624a29ea7 (athena, workspace sase_29): a complete 'just test-visual' run is 972 passed / 1 skipped with created=0 updated=0 unchanged=709 stale=0; test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot and test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot both ran in that suite (12.15s and 12.78s) and passed with unchanged goldens. Not closed because signature 2 in this report (a stable 491-pixel mismatch in a detached /tmp git worktree run) was never explained and is not covered by a workspace-checkout run.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 on host apollo, workspace sase_17 (the workspace checkout, not a /tmp worktree), master 624a29ea72, on a CLEAN tree (local changes stashed): 'just fix-tui-screenshots --check -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_fleet.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py' passes all 9 tests (no DONE-sentinel timeout) but reports check=drift, updated=3: agents_retry_e2e_countdown_120x40, agents_retry_e2e_completed_chain_120x40 and agents_fleet_remote_tribe_families_120x40. This is the stable render-then-golden-mismatch signature (signature 2), and it contradicts the note that sase-12z.5 fixed it: sase-12z.5.land reported 0 updated at this same commit on athena/sase_29, so the drift looks host- or renderer-specific (apollo). The completed_chain node (test_real_fakey_completed_retry_chain_png_snapshot) is not named in this report or its siblings. Do not regenerate goldens from apollo without first explaining the host difference.

payload.entry:
TRIAGE VERIFIED FIXED (2026-09-20, athena workspace sase_34, master ec7dbbfdf == origin/master). Both signatures in this report were re-tested and both pass, which is what the earlier 'LIKELY FIXED BY sase-12z.5' note asked for before closing.

Signature 1 (workspace checkout, 15s DONE-sentinel timeout): 'just test-visual -- -k "test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot or test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot"' passes both nodes (30.6s and 35.3s, no sentinel timeout) with counts created=0 updated=0 unchanged=7 stale=0 and 'check clean'.

Signature 2 (the unexplained 491/1520532-pixel golden mismatch in a detached /tmp git worktree): reproduced the exact reported recipe -- 'git worktree add --detach /tmp/sase13v_wt HEAD', then 'PYTHONPATH=/tmp/sase13v_wt:/tmp/sase13v_wt/src .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest visual -k ...' -- and both nodes now render and match their goldens (2 passed in 143s, exit 0). The path-dependent 491-pixel drift does not reproduce at this master, so the workspace-vs-worktree divergence the report could not explain is resolved along with signature 1 rather than being a separate defect. Root cause stands as recorded: the sase-13i.2 identity-only repaint skip, restored by 9a56fc129.

payload.close_reason: Both reported signatures are gone at master ec7dbbfdf; fixed by 9a56fc129 (phase sase-12z.5.2)
